get.description: Structured MLflow report scoped to a single run (filtered to its session ids).
Structured MLflow report aggregated across an experiment's runs (time-windowed).
Effective Service-enacted config for the caller's instance, secrets redacted.

put.description: Set/update Service-enactable config (MLflow, S3). Workload creds are rejected (422).

ConfigResponse.title: ConfigResponse
ConfigResponse.description: Effective Service-enacted config for an instance, with secret fields redacted.

ConfigUpdateRequest.title: ConfigUpdateRequest
ConfigUpdateRequest.description:
Benchmarker-only config update. Accepts ONLY parameters the Service can enact.

`extra="forbid"` is the guard: an attempt to set a workload-provided credential
(e.g. `hf-secret`) — which the Service never sets — is rejected as 422. Workload
credentials are provisioned out-of-band and verified by the workload precheck.

MLflowTraceRecord.title: MLflowTraceRecord
MLflowTraceRecord.description:
One `Agent.Session` trace aggregated into a structured record.

Mirrors the upstream harness `TraceRecord`: per-session timing breakdown,
LLM/tool latencies + token counts, infra CPU/mem, and evaluation outcome —
parsed out of the OTEL spans the workload pods export to MLflow.

ReportAggregate.title: ReportAggregate
ReportAggregate.description: Per-group rollup for an experiment report.

RunArtifact.title: RunArtifact
RunArtifact.description:
A single S3 object exported for a completed run.

Surfaced in the run/report payload so a client can selectively fetch only the file(s) it
needs (e.g. Parquet for analytics, NDJSON for streaming) instead of the full inline records.

S3Config.title: S3Config
S3Config.description:
Service-enacted object store for hosting benchmark-result artifacts.

Consumed by the Service itself (not the workload pods), so it is set/updated via
the benchmarker-only config API rather than provisioned as a cluster Secret.

ToolCreateRequest.title: ToolCreateRequest
ToolCreateRequest.description: An MCP tool/benchmark-server workload deployed via Rossoctl POST /api/v1/tools.

bearerAuth.description: Caller JWT. Used only for attribution (preferred_username) and issuer-based routing (iss); never forwarded upstream — the Service mints its own ROPC token for Rossoctl calls.
